_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Typing neither rewrites stylesheets nor re-renders the conversation. window.countTypingEffects() starts counting <style> rewrites and DOM mutations in the messages list; window.typingEffects() returns the counts as JSON. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/typing and wait (up to 30s) for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Add messages so the conversation scrolls, for each N of 1, 2 and 3 in turn: fill the message input with "echo message N", click the send button (data-testid "send-button"), wait (up to 30s) until the last element containing the text "echo message N" is visible, then wait (up to 30s) until the agent-thinking indicator (data-testid "agent-thinking") is hidden. 3. Scroll the messages to the top: eval document.querySelector('.messages-container').scrollTop = 0. 4. The scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button", which has a tooltip) should become visible (up to 10s). 5. Eval window.countTypingEffects(), which returns "counting". 6. Click the message input, then type "hello performance world" key by key (a type step, not fill). 7. Right away, eval window.typingEffects(); it must be exactly {"styleWrites":0,"messagesListPatches":0}.
